description: Source code for a Breakpad crash report uploader, handling configuration, minidump and log file reading, and network upload logic.

classes.name: Uploader
classes.description: Handles crash report uploading, including configuration parsing, minidump and log file reading, and network communication.

methods.name: initWithConfigFile
methods.description: Initializes Uploader with configuration from a file.

methods.name: initWithConfig
methods.description: Initializes Uploader with a configuration dictionary.

methods.name: translateConfigurationData
methods.description: Processes configuration data, sets parameters, and generates client ID.

methods.name: clientID
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a persistent unique client ID.

methods.name: readLogFileData
methods.description: Reads and compresses log files for upload.

methods.name: readMinidumpData
methods.description: Reads minidump file into memory, respecting size limits.

methods.name: dictionaryForServerType
methods.description: Returns URL parameter mapping for a given server type.

methods.name: urlParameterDictionary
methods.description: Retrieves URL parameter mapping based on current server type.

methods.name: populateServerDictionary
methods.description: Populates crash report parameters with URL mappings.

methods.name: handleNetworkResponse
methods.description: Processes server response after upload, renames minidump file.

methods.name: uploadData
methods.description: Uploads arbitrary data with a specified name.

methods.name: logUploadWithID
methods.description: Logs the upload report ID to a log file.
